facts.fact: Finance SAO reports the BCEAO communique of 25 June 2026 set 30 September 2026 as the new deadline to integrate with PI-SPI for banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions in the UEMOA, Niger included, and 30 June 2027 for microfinance institutions.
